question: What API endpoint do I use to delete a voice?
ground_truth: Use the DELETE /v1/voices/{voice_id} endpoint, passing the voice_id as a path parameter. You need to authenticate with the xi-api-key header. On success (200), the response contains a 'status' field (string). A 422 response indicates a validation error. You can get the voice_id of voices to delete by first listing your voices using the GET /v1/voices endpoint.
